about: Single source of the Azure resource library: every Azure service a project or the common part can switch on. The default of each setting is read from environment_setup/aifactory/variables.json when the page is built. templates lists the service names of code_templates.json that use the resource.

not_listed.enablePersonas: Access model of the project team, not an Azure service.
not_listed.enableAIFactoryHub: Hub mode, see Hub and network modes.
not_listed.enablePublicGenAIAccess: Networking mode, not an Azure service.
not_listed.enablePublicAccessWithPerimeter: Networking mode, not an Azure service.
not_listed.enableEncryptionAtHost: Option of the virtual machines and AKS nodes.
not_listed.enableDeleteForDisabledResources: Delete switch, explained on the home page.

resources.name: Microsoft Foundry
resources.summary: The Foundry account and project of the team: model deployments, prompt agents, hosted agents and Foundry IQ.

resources.name: Foundry agent service with your own resources
resources.summary: Private agents that keep their threads, files and vectors in your Cosmos DB, Storage and AI Search. Needs those three services.

resources.name: Azure AI Search
resources.summary: The index for RAG and Foundry IQ knowledge bases, and the vector store of private agents.

resources.name: Azure Bot Service
resources.summary: Publishes a Foundry agent to Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot. Name the agent in botFoundryAgentName.

resources.name: ESAF Agent Chat
resources.summary: A chat agent that answers questions about your Factory and its documentation. Needs Foundry and a chat model deployment.

resources.name: Agent Chat live voice
resources.summary: Talk to Agent Chat with Azure Voice Live. Needs Agent Chat, Container Apps, Foundry and AI Search.

resources.name: Private Azure MCP server
resources.summary: A private, read-only MCP server that gives your agents tools for the Azure resources of the project.

resources.name: Factory MCP server
resources.summary: The read-only tools of the Factory as an MCP server on Container Apps. Needs Foundry and Container Apps.

resources.name: AI gateway in Foundry
resources.summary: Creates or adopts the AI gateway of the Foundry account. Add the Factory MCP server to it with addAIFactoryMCP2AIGatewaySKU.

resources.name: Azure OpenAI (standalone)
resources.summary: A separate Azure OpenAI account, for workloads that need one beside Foundry.

resources.name: Azure AI Speech
resources.summary: Speech to text and text to speech.

resources.name: Azure AI Vision
resources.summary: Image analysis and optical character recognition.

resources.name: Azure AI Document Intelligence
resources.summary: Extracts text, tables and fields from documents, for example before indexing them.

resources.name: Azure AI Content Safety
resources.summary: Detects harmful content in prompts and answers.

resources.name: Grounding with Bing Search
resources.summary: Lets an agent ground its answers in web search results.

resources.name: Grounding with Bing Custom Search
resources.summary: Web grounding that is limited to the sites you choose.

resources.name: Azure Machine Learning
resources.summary: The workspace for training, pipelines, the model registry and endpoints.

resources.name: AKS for Azure Machine Learning
resources.summary: A private AKS cluster attached to the workspace for online inference. Needs Azure Machine Learning.

resources.name: Azure Databricks
resources.summary: A Databricks workspace for Spark data processing and model training.

resources.name: Azure Web App
resources.summary: App Service for the web front end or the API of your application.

resources.name: Azure Function App
resources.summary: Serverless functions for APIs and event handlers.

resources.name: Azure Container Apps
resources.summary: Runs your containers: chat apps, APIs and MCP servers.

resources.name: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
resources.summary: A standalone AKS cluster in the project, for applications that need Kubernetes.

resources.name: Azure SQL Database
resources.summary: A relational database for your application.

resources.name: Azure Database for PostgreSQL
resources.summary: A PostgreSQL flexible server for your application.

resources.name: Azure Cosmos DB
resources.summary: A NoSQL database for your application. Private Foundry agents also keep their threads here.

resources.name: Azure Cache for Redis
resources.summary: An in-memory cache for sessions and fast lookups.

resources.name: Azure Managed Redis
resources.summary: A private Azure Managed Redis that accepts Entra ID sign-in only.

resources.name: Elasticsearch
resources.summary: Elastic Cloud as a managed search and analytics store.

resources.name: Azure API Management as the AI gateway
resources.summary: One endpoint in front of a pool of model deployments, with retries when a backend is throttled. It can also publish the Factory MCP server.

resources.name: Kong as the AI gateway
resources.summary: The alternative to API Management: an open-source Kong gateway in the common network, alone or in front of API Management.

resources.name: Azure Data Factory
resources.summary: Orchestrates ingestion and data movement for the project.

resources.name: Azure Data Factory (common)
resources.summary: A Data Factory in the common resource group, shared by the projects of the scale set.

resources.name: Azure Event Hubs
resources.summary: Event streams, for example for streaming inference.

resources.name: Azure Logic Apps
resources.summary: Workflows that connect your application to other systems.

resources.name: Application Insights
resources.summary: Telemetry of the project's applications and agents.

resources.name: Application Insights dashboard
resources.summary: A portal dashboard on top of Application Insights.

resources.name: Azure Monitor Private Link Scope
resources.summary: Private ingestion to Application Insights and Log Analytics.

resources.name: Defender for AI (subscription)
resources.summary: Switches on Microsoft Defender for AI for the whole subscription.

resources.name: Defender for AI (resource)
resources.summary: Switches on Microsoft Defender for AI for each AI resource of the project.

resources.name: Azure Backup for virtual machines
resources.summary: Backs up the admin and project virtual machines to a Recovery Services vault.

resources.name: Azure Bastion
resources.summary: A Bastion host in the common resource group, to reach the virtual machines without a public IP address.

resources.name: Admin virtual machine
resources.summary: A virtual machine in the common resource group for the platform team.

resources.name: Project virtual machine
resources.summary: A private virtual machine in the project resource group, for work inside the network.
